description: Implement runtime capture backend selection on Windows: try DXGI Desktop Duplication first, fall back to WGC if DD fails (Secure Desktop, permission denied, exclusive fullscreen). On Linux, PipeWire remains the only path. Selection logic lives in engine/mod.rs, emits diagnostic events for which backend was chosen and why. Includes retry with backoff on transient DXGI errors.
title: Capture backend auto-selection and fallback chain
